input_save.name: Foundation III 250616 0Y.zip
input_save.current_header: 2.0.55 / 35 mods; original initial 2.0.32 / 30 mods is a distinct historical header

independent_expected_result.completion_requires: Exactly 600 ticks after first observation; native deltas retained, negative/reset counters and invalidated objects explicit; callback retired before COMPLETE.
independent_expected_result.activity_requires: Positive selected native production or sampled products_finished delta; entity count alone never qualifies activity.
independent_expected_result.read_only: No storage, research, entity, inventory, setting, GUI, save or file writes; native chronological log only.

execution_handoff.existing_runner: Existing governed protected-save benchmark/admission caller; no new runner.
execution_handoff.before: Independently verify source and all actual archive/member/engine pins, current-world selection and inherited settings; stage only the owned observer with existing exclusive library custody; use a fresh disposable save copy and freeze the exact diagnostic caller/profile/packet.
execution_handoff.run: Use the existing 3600-tick diagnostic benchmark path and exact 2.0.77/D3 engine, keeping the first complete 600-tick log observation separate from benchmark timing. Native log must retain START and COMPLETE JSON; sanitized aggregate output alone is insufficient.
execution_handoff.after: Preserve full terminal engine log, measurements, original/owned/staged save hashes and control restoration. Review useful work and actual scale independently.
execution_handoff.failure: Preserve failed run/log/input identity before any relaunch. No completion or activity claim from partial rows. Diagnose missing work or a concrete bound separately; do not weaken bounds or change player behavior to pass.

limits: Diagnostic-only instrumentation is excluded from scored startup/runtime/memory comparisons. No overhead subtraction.
No native dispatch, completed activity, scale qualification, saved-state preservation, stall attribution, percentile or performance acceptance claimed.
Normal-quality production counters cover only 15 named items. Bounded native-order machine samples are not random or whole-factory estimates.
Source settings, dependency updates and any F210 removed-mod route require their own actual-input review. F210 observer payload does not establish a matching Foundation profile.
Old 30-row admission and all prior adverse/accepted results retain their original identities.
